description: The fields you can filter (filter.facet) and group by (by: facet:<key>): each judgment's definition, values, source, judges, measured quality (labels by Claude annotators, not humans) with its tier, and coverage in your scope over the last 28 days (on the counted engines); the engine facet lists every AI surface with its class and data in your scope; plus this workspace's custom cf_ facets from apply_rubric, query_metrics' measures with their definitions, and how agent numbers relate to the dashboard's. measuresOfImportance documents search_reach, retrieved_by, engine_reach and memory_gap: what each is, the calls that read it, and the evidence behind it with the date measured. Free.
